features.label: Security Round
features.aiPrompt: You are an AI analyst for A I Museum Cultural Institution Manager. Analyze the provided Security Round data. The data includes: Officer, Date, Start Time, End Time, Zone, Status, Findings, Incidents, Doors Checked, Cameras Reviewed, Notes. Provide insights, recommendations, identify patterns, flag potential issues, and suggest optimizations. Return a structured JSON response with sections for summary, key_metrics, recommendations, and risk_factors.
